title: Research: serialize independent dirty connectors without extra calls
body:
## Summary

```text
independent dirty roots
  -> stably group calls by root
  -> reuse one restored dirty row
  -> preserve every named map-call count
```

Prove this reduction for every finite universal connector word with immutable sources and unobserved additive outputs. It extends Adam Gall's PR2063 five-source tariff and sixteen minimal aggregate profiles to any number of uncoupled roots. The unit map bill remains 74. Extra workspace alone cannot lower it.

Add the checked serializer, proof, exact source pins and replay package. Credit PR943/1770/1811/2063 and the complementary transfer-coupled PR1498/1615/2065 lineage. No supplier or kappa improvement is claimed. Root transfers, nonuniform port prices, intermediate observations and physical setup/routing bills retain separate contracts.

## Evidence

- Before: identifying interleaved roots without grouping corrupts the two singleton outputs. The actual faulty producer is rejected.
- After: separate formal-symbol and full-matrix engines agree on all 87,381 bounded words and 8,909 accepted endpoints. There are 15,699 dense forward/inverse pairs, sixteen exposed price fixtures and four behavioral groups. Optimized Git-free scientific replays pass on Python 3.12.15 and 3.15.0; pinned Ruff checks pass. The final additive commit changes only review-status metadata and its README pointer. Fourteen scientific/input files retain their checked hashes; final-head metadata, source ancestry and committed-byte checks pass.

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-connector-serialization
```

The unbounded claim rests on PROOF.md. The finite checks corroborate it. The original one-root lower tariff is inherited; its historical census, selected cold replay, formal kernel and physical supplier admission are not rerun.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2049#discussioncomment-19009168

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only the new research package changes. Frozen inputs, predecessor packages and the selected frontier are unchanged. Hosted CI and independent human review are unverified.
